title: KNBS national marketed crop production (volume), Kenya
license: KNBS — public official statistics; cite KNBS.
method: Deterministic pass-through of the banked, dual-engine-validated KNBS extraction (pdfplumber + PyMuPDF word-clustering; latest edition per crop×year). No LLM/transcription — the model never read or typed a value. Only rows with dual_validated=true are kept. Per-row provenance retained: edition, source_file, pdf_page.
resolution: NATIONAL (Kenya), by commodity. This is the nationally-reported marketed series; NOT county-level.

columns.crop: commodity (coffee, cotton, maize, pyrethrum extract, rice, sisal, sugarcane, tea, wheat)
columns.edition: KNBS Statistical Abstract edition the value came from
columns.pdf_page: page in that PDF (a human can open it)
columns.dual_validated: passed the dual-engine (pdfplumber vs PyMuPDF) agreement gate

scope_note: Marketed production (crops sold through formal channels / boards), national. NOT on-farm total production, NOT county-level. Pairs with the AFA county returns (subnational food-crop production, 2020–24) shown alongside — the two are different agencies, crop sets and bases; labelled distinctly.
used_by: notebook.qmd Key Facts — 'What does my county produce?' national reference panel
